layout.arrangement: Thin dark-red border frame around the whole white slide. Two-line bold centered title at top (line 1 has yellow highlight on the parenthetical; line 2 has red subscripted X symbols); yellow '28' circle badge at top-right. Below, one large peach rounded panel (~4-94% width, ~19-98% height) contains the entire self-attention flow diagram, reading left to right: left embedding stack (4 blocks) -> tan 'Dot Product' box (yellow 'Similarity' oval above) -> tall pink 'Soft max' bar (yellow 'Probabilities' oval above) -> four red ⊗ multiply nodes labeled W₂₁-W₂₄ -> light-blue 'Σ' box (yellow 'Weighted SUM' oval above) -> thick green arrow up to output 'Y' block; right embedding stack (4 blocks) feeds the ⊗ nodes from the right; bottom row of four token blocks (X₄, X₂ highlighted, X₁, X₃) sends a red arrow up into the Dot Product box; green annotation box bottom-center; red/blue 'Positional Encoder' box bottom-right.

visual_elements.description: Self-attention dataflow for query X₂. NODES: (a) Left embedding stack: 4 rounded blocks with dashed green borders, each containing a horizontal 4-cell strip [yellow | pink cell with red label | green | yellow]; labels top->bottom X₄, X₃, X₂, X₁. (b) Tan 'Dot Product' rectangle with 4 dark-blue dots (light-blue centers) in a descending diagonal. (c) Tall pink vertical bar with rotated text 'Soft max'. (d) Four red ⊗ (circled-multiply) nodes stacked vertically, labeled at their left W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄ in dark blue. (e) Light-blue rectangle with black 'Σ'. (f) Output block: dashed-green rounded block with strip labeled 'Y'. (g) Right embedding stack: same 4 strip-blocks labeled X₄, X₃, X₂, X₁. (h) Bottom token row: 4 dashed-green strip-blocks labeled X₄, X₂ (pink-highlighted), X₁, X₃. ARROWS: 4 red horizontal arrows left-stack -> blue dots (arrowheads at dots); thin red fan lines inside the tan box from the base of the vertical red arrow up to each dot; thin red lines dots -> Softmax bar; red lines Softmax -> each ⊗; 4 red horizontal arrows right-stack -> ⊗ nodes (arrowheads pointing left); 4 red vertical arrows ⊗ -> Σ (arrowheads up into Σ); thick green block arrow Σ -> Y output block (pointing up); red vertical arrow bottom-row X₂ -> Dot Product box (arrowhead up); dark-red 3D block arrow at bottom-left pointing at the X₂ token; two dashed green curved arrows from the ends of the bottom token row curving up to the bottoms of the left and right embedding stacks (arrowheads up).
Three yellow ovals (black outline, black bold text) naming the pipeline stages: 'Similarity' (above Dot Product box), 'Probabilities' (above Softmax bar), 'Weighted SUM' (above Σ box).

recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: white background; draw a no-fill rectangle with ~2.5pt dark-red (#C00000) outline inset ~0.3cm around the entire slide as a frame.
2. Title text box (centered, full width, top ~4-12%): line 1 'Self Attention Mechanism ' bold black ~22pt Arial + '(Not Sensitive to Words Order)' bold black with yellow (#FFFF00) highlight. Line 2 ~20pt bold: '(Self Attention of word ' black + 'X' red with subscript '2' + ' w.r.t All words in Sentence ( ' black + 'X' red sub '4' + ', ' + 'X' red sub '2' + ', ' + 'X' red sub '1' + ', ' + 'X' red sub '3' + ' )'.
3. Slide badge: 1.2cm yellow (#FFFF99) circle, dark outline, at ~93% width / 13% height, text '28' black bold 12pt.
4. Diagram canvas: peach (#FCE3C3) rounded rectangle from 4%-94% width, 19%-98% height; send to back.
5. Build one 'embedding block' group: rounded rectangle, white fill, 1.5pt dashed green (#00A000) border, containing 4 adjacent small cells colored yellow (#FFFF99), pink (#FF99CC), green (#90EE90), yellow; put a red bold subscripted label in the pink cell. Duplicate for: left stack (labels X₄, X₃, X₂, X₁ top->bottom; 6-15% w, 42-73% h), right stack (same labels; 80-88% w, 42-73% h), output block labeled 'Y' (57-67% w, 22-27% h), and bottom row (labels X₄, X₂, X₁, X₃; 19-51% w, 88-95% h — fill the X₂ block's cells with stronger pink and a red outline to highlight it).
6. Dot Product box: tan (#C8A165) rectangle 26-36% w, 36-74% h; bold dark text 'Dot' / 'Product' (two lines) at top; place 4 circles (dark-blue #00008B ring, light-blue #87CEEB center) in a descending diagonal inside.
7. Softmax bar: pink-violet (#EE82EE) vertical rectangle 48-51% w, 36-74% h; add text box 'Soft max' rotated 270° (reads bottom-to-top), dark bold.
8. Three yellow ovals (#FFFF99 fill, black outline, black bold ~11pt): 'Similarity' above the Dot Product box; 'Probabilities' above the Softmax bar; 'Weighted SUM' above the Σ box.
9. Σ box: light-blue (#ADD8E6) rectangle 54-68% w, 36-41% h with large black bold 'Σ' centered.
10. Multiply nodes: four red (#CC0000) circles (~0.5cm) each containing a bold '×' (or the ⊗ character), stacked at ~57% width at ~44/52/59/66% height; to each left, dark-blue (#00008B) bold label with subscript: W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄.
11. Arrows (all #CC0000, ~1.25pt): four horizontal arrows left-stack -> the four blue dots; thin lines from the base point of step 12's arrow fanning up to each dot; thin lines dots -> Softmax bar; lines Softmax right edge -> each ⊗; four horizontal arrows right-stack -> ⊗ nodes (arrowheads pointing left); four vertical arrows ⊗ -> Σ bottom edge (arrowheads up).
12. Red vertical arrow from top of bottom-row X₂ block (~29% width) up to the Dot Product box bottom (arrowhead up). Add a dark-red 3D 'Block Arrow' shape (black outline) at ~27-31% w, ~93-98% h pointing up-right at the X₂ token.
13. Thick green (#00A000) block arrow from Σ box top pointing up into the 'Y' output block.
14. Two dashed green (#00A000) curved connectors: from the left end of the bottom token row curving up to the bottom of the left stack, and from the right end curving up to the bottom of the right stack (arrowheads up).
15. Annotation boxes: white rounded rectangle at 40-75% w, 79-85% h with green (#008000) bold text 'Sequential nature of the input is IGNORED'; white rectangle at 76-93% w, 85-96% h with line 1 red bold 'Mitigated Later with' and line 2 blue (#0000FF) bold italic 'Positional Encoder'.
16. Optional (only for pixel-faithful screenshot match): add a small mouse-cursor icon near W₂₃; it is a recording artifact, not part of the original slide.
